close_reason: Done in commit b2ab031. Reframed as idempotent join: same-caller TOCTOU dedups to one entry and succeeds rather than serverFailing. Extracted dedup_caller_members() with 6 unit tests covering empty / single / two-dup / three-dup / bystander / malformed cases.
description:
Site: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs:1462-1499.

When the TOCTOU re-read detects duplicate_count > 1, the loser's recovery removes its entry by matching:
    m.get("id") == account_id AND m.get("joinedAt") == now_str

now_utc_string() returns ISO 8601 seconds-precision: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

If two requests from the same account race (which is the exact case this code claims to handle), both record their joinedAt as 'now' at roughly the same wall-clock moment. If the second-precision strings collide (very plausible: the entire race window is sub-second), the recovery's filter matches both entries:
- removed_ours latches on the FIRST match, removes only that one,
- but the surviving entry is also 'ours' (same id, same joinedAt) — we've left the winner with our entry, removed the duplicate, but the user is now reported as 'failed to join' even though they ARE a member.

The handler returns serverFail; client retries; pre-check passes (still not a member from their perspective? no, they ARE a member — the surviving entry — so pre-check FAILS with 'already a member', cycling them into a retry-loop or false-failure.

The bug is reachable but narrow: requires (a) the same account_id issuing two concurrent join requests via two different invites (or one invite path + one public-space path) AND (b) collision in second-precision joinedAt strings.

Fix: include sub-second precision in joinedAt, or use a request-id nonce in the recovery filter, or use a server-assigned per-member nonce that the kit owns.

This bead is P2 rather than P0 because the trigger requires both same-account double-joining AND the TOCTOU path firing — uncommon but real. The wider concurrency story for handle_space_join is tracked by JMAP-x2gd.2 (invite uses race).
title: Space/join TOCTOU dedup matches joinedAt with second precision; concurrent same-account joins can dedup wrong entry
